carousel.description: Connected sensors measure your vital signs in real time: blood pressure, pulse, weight and temperature. Data is transmitted automatically to the platform.
Your doctor accesses your complete medical file from their dashboard. They can consult your measurement history and track your health status.
Our AI module continuously analyzes your medical data. When an anomaly is detected (high blood pressure, abnormal pulse), an alert is automatically sent.
In critical situations, the patient and doctor receive an immediate notification. The doctor can act quickly without waiting for the next consultation.
Prescriptions validated by the doctor are transmitted directly to the partner pharmacy. The patient can collect their medications without delay.
All your medical data is encrypted and protected. Access is role-controlled: only authorized professionals can view your file.
